## ID conventions — trace with `grep`, not with memory

| Prefix | Meaning | Source of truth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `US-01` | user journey | [`01-product/journeys.md`](01-product/journeys.md) |
| `FR-01` | function | [`02-requirements/scope.md`](02-requirements/scope.md) |
| `NFR-PERF-01` | non-functional threshold | [`02-requirements/nfr.md`](02-requirements/nfr.md) |
| `I1` | load-bearing invariant | [`03-design/invariants.md`](03-design/invariants.md) |
| `ADR-0001` | technical decision | [`decisions/`](decisions/README.md) |

- IDs are **never reused and never deleted**. Dropping an item means marking it
  `(bỏ)` / `~~(dropped)~~` and keeping the number.
- Feature documents, commit bodies and tests **reference IDs**; they do not copy the
  content across.
- Trace one requirement: `grep -rn "NFR-PERF-01" .`
- An ID mentioned somewhere with no entry in its source file is reported by
  `docs-regen.sh` as orphaned.

## Language

Documentation here is **English**, matching the rule in the root
[`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md). One file is still Vietnamese in the body and carries an
English header only:

- [`05-operations/runbook.md`](05-operations/runbook.md) — 533 lines of deploy steps and
  exact commands; translating it risks corrupting a command for no functional gain.

It is flagged rather than silently mixed. Translating it is an open choice, not an
oversight.

The automation under `.claude/scripts/` still speaks Vietnamese in its reminders. Those
messages are addressed to the model mid-session, never to a reader of this repo, and the
header keys the scripts parse accept **either** language — see
[`../.claude/CLAUDE.md`](../.claude/CLAUDE.md).

## History

This tier replaced three earlier documents on 2026-09-13. Their content lives on here;
the files themselves remain in git history:

| Deleted | Where its content went |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/status.md` | [`04-state/backlog.md`](04-state/backlog.md) |
| `docs/session-log.md` | [`decisions/`](decisions/README.md) (ADR-0001…0016) · [`03-design/invariants.md`](03-design/invariants.md) |
| `docs/superpowers/{specs,plans}/` | [`01-product/`](01-product/overview.md) · [`02-requirements/`](02-requirements/scope.md) · [`03-design/`](03-design/architecture.md) |
| `docs/operations.md` | moved to [`05-operations/runbook.md`](05-operations/runbook.md) |

New feature documents go to `docs/specs/<feature>/`, one folder per feature — not the
dated `superpowers/specs` + `superpowers/plans` split, which scattered one feature's
documents across two trees.

The **commit log remains a design journal** and is not superseded by this tier:

```bash
git log --format='%h %s%n%b'
```
